title: Munch Maze
description: The 1980 dot-eating maze chase, rebuilt at the arcade's 224x288 with the documented rules: the same maze and 244 dots, four ghosts that each hunt their own way, scatter and chase waves, per-level speed and fright tables, Cruise Elroy, the ghost-house counters, fruit and the tunnel. Swipe to steer. Clear the maze, level up, chase the high score.
